reviews.title: Excellent customer service
reviews.comment:
I originally purchased an open-box motherboard listed in excellent condition. When I arrived to pick it up, the store informed me that the item was no longer available. Instead of canceling the order or offering a downgrade, they promptly provided me with a brand-new, factory-sealed unit at no extra cost.

This experience really shows a strong commitment to customer satisfaction and professionalism. It’s great to see a company stand behind its customers and go above expectations to resolve an issue quickly and fairly.

Very satisfied with both the product and the service.
